scope: Targets for the planned production release. Current measurements do not satisfy or qualify these limits.

runner.platform_scope: These four platforms receive initial numeric latency qualification. All six published archive targets still require native functional qualification. Other latency claims require a profile revision.

workload.latency_target_state: warm valid policy and credentials, pooled connections, cache disabled or miss; evaluate cache hits separately
workload.size_definition: Input bytes are the JSON request body. Output bytes apply to non-stream content. Stream content is stream_events times event_content_bytes. Token counts are controlled upstream usage fields.

resources.measurement_definition: Request allocation limits cover gateway work per request, excluding separately counted per-event work. Event limits apply to each forwarded content event. Profiles must exclude client and controlled upstream frames.

evidence.minimum_duration_rule: Each variant must meet both the minimum duration and sample count. Streams at 50 requests/s need at least 2000 seconds per run.
evidence.boundary_definition: Compute each proxied-minus-direct difference after removing only measured deliberate upstream waits on each side. Report complete handler time separately. First-byte and first-token differences use matching milestones. Event forwarding runs from upstream emission to client receipt.
evidence.confidence_method: Report a 95-percent confidence interval per percentile and variant using a documented order-statistic or bootstrap method. A release passes only if the upper bound meets the target in every run.
evidence.regression_rule: A repeatable regression above 10 percent requires investigation and review even when the absolute limit passes. Never adjust a target to hide a regression.

rationale.latency: Small uncached warm requests should spend microseconds on indexed local reads and bounded protocol work. Fleet limits add room for one required admission round trip.
rationale.allocations: Remove the measured full-provider copies before pooling or GC tuning. Complete protocol requests may allocate, but work must stay bounded.
rationale.correctness: A latency target never permits skipping required budget admission or using expired authority.
rationale.measurement: The local baseline identifies costs. A dedicated runner and the full recipe matrix must establish release claims.
